messages:
Ava: Uploaded a new launch blog draft: https://drive.redwood.co/launch-v3. Need quick reads on benchmark wording (we currently say ~2.5x) and webinar CTA routing. Target: lock by EOD tomorrow.

Priya: On benchmarks. Can you include a short method note here? Even one line about request size and batching.

Ava: Added: 'avg request ~120 tokens; continuous batching + KV prefix cache enabled; medians over 10k requests.' Keeping claim as 'up to 2.5x lower token cost in our internal benchmarks.'

Jon: Good. Legal prefers "up to" hedging and a link to methodology. @LegalBot please confirm.

LegalBot: Automated pass: "up to" ok. Add disclaimer: 'Results may vary by workload' and link to full methodology. No customer names.

Marco: CTA routing proposal for HubSpot (pseudocode):
```
if (event==='attend') hubspot.flow='attendees-deck-demo';
else if (event==='register_no_show') hubspot.flow='replay-nurture';
else hubspot.flow='general-inbound';
```
Add utm_campaign variants and tag lead_source=launch_blog.

Ava: Added snippet and UTM defaults (utm_source=blog, utm_medium=post). Lina: UX?

Lina: Primary button: "Register for webinar"; secondary: "Technical notes". Mobile: stack buttons. Add inline replay link under intro paragraph.

Ava: Done. Publish checklist to @PublishBot: final copy in CMS, hero image on CDN, webhook configured, social scheduled. Can you run a smoke webhook test at publish?

PublishBot: Smoke test scheduled for 2026-06-03T16:00:00Z. Will confirm here after test. :robot_face:

Ava: Pushed final edits (headline softened to avoid overclaim). Thanks team.

PublishBot: Smoke webhook OK at 2026-06-03T16:02:12Z  routed to flow `attendees-deck-demo`.

Jon: Final nit: change 'production-grade' -> 'production-ready'. All good from me.

Ava: Updated and locked in CMS. Publishing per schedule after legal signoff in doc. :party_parrot:
